metadata.description: PrezServices' Claude Code plugins, grouped by category.

plugins.name: prez-rails
plugins.description: prez rails: an autonomous delivery system for meta-repos. Tickets as contracts, engineer curation, ticket worktrees, review, deploy and QA.

plugins.name: pstack-rails
plugins.description: pstack rails: runs a workspace on pstack (Cursor's pstack@cursor-plugins). Points every session at /pstack:poteto-mode, keeps subagents to pstack's agents, and ports the cursor-team-kit skills pstack names.

plugins.name: pstack
plugins.description: pstack, Lauren Tan's agent workflows, fetched from Cursor's repo (cursor/plugins, harness/pstack/claude-code), not copied. Listed here so pstack-rails can install it as a dependency; install pstack-rails rather than this.

plugins.name: company-ops
plugins.description: company-ops: runs the company, not the code. Standardises the documents a company keeps (roadmaps now; CRM and outreach next) on one workspace config of entities, knowledge base and doc conventions.
